context: The eval checks whether the review lens suite catches a realistic data-integrity and resilience regression caused by removing idempotency from a retrying payment job.

checklist.name: Finds duplicate charge risk
checklist.description: Explains that if payments.charge succeeds but the worker receives a transient error before markPaid, the retried job can charge the same invoice again

checklist.name: Connects risk to removed idempotency key
checklist.description: Points specifically to the removed idempotencyKey and the retry behavior, not just a vague concern about retries

checklist.name: Names persisted data impact
checklist.description: States that customer payment state can diverge from invoice state or require refund/repair after duplicate external side effects

checklist.name: Gives a minimal containment
checklist.description: Proposes restoring the stable idempotency key or otherwise making payment side effects idempotent before marking the invoice paid

checklist.name: Avoids impossible transaction advice
checklist.description: Does not propose wrapping the external payment provider call and local database write in a single ordinary database transaction as the sole fix
